notes.title: v1.03: New UI & Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for playing Plastris! I'm surprised to see that it's one of my most popular Steam releases (out of the 9 games I uploaded here so far), and I'd like to repay you for your support.

I returned to Plastris to release a small, but handy update. It addresses one of the game's biggest issues (players not knowing what to do when they first launch the game) and fixes a few minor bugs.

[b]New stuff:[/b]
- Added 2 new UI elements which show what "plus" and "minus" shapes are available to you on the current level.

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Upon returning to menu, you'll now see the level selection page that contains your last played level (useful for clearing skipped levels).

[b]Fixed bugs:[/b]
- Cursor is now always properly changing when hovering over UI elements.
- Environment (crystal cave/desert/winter) no longer "forgets" to change to a different one after a few levels.
- Each environment now has the intended saturation & contrast settings.

I hope you'll enjoy these changes. Happy holidays! :)

Yours sincerely,
Ivan (Khud0)

notes.title: v1.01 - Multiple Platforms, Minor QoL Changes
notes.content:
Dear Players,

In this tiny update I implemented a few "quality of life" features, suggested by our wonderful community:

- Pause button (Also "Escape" and "P" shortcuts) will now take you to the level selection screen instead of the main menu. (Suggested by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/dohi64]Dohi64[/url]).

- Left / Right arrows on your keyboard can now be used to load previous and next level accordingly. (Suggested by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/dohi64]Dohi64[/url]).

- Sound / music settings will be applied immediately upon changing their values. (Suggested by multiple people).

- Sound effects should no longer interrupt each other in certain occasions.

- In addition to Windows, Plastris should now work on Mac OS X and Linux. I say "should", because I have nothing to test these versions on, so if something goes wrong don't hesitate to let me know [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1227860/discussions/0/2152098711360571782/]in this forum topic[/url].

If you'd like to contribute to the game by sharing your suggestions with me, please leave them on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1227860/discussions/]"Discussions" forum[/url]. :)

I hope that you will enjoy the changes and we will meet again soon. ːgrizzland_heartː

Yours forever,
Khud0
